source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Run CPU stress tool (EX: linpack) to heat system
2. Check if CPU with maximum Watts.
3. Set the all system fans speed to low. And check if CPU thermal to high , frequency should be get lower, BMC SEL have log about PROCHOT throttling and CPU power usage become lower in the same time
4. Power off system and recover fan controller.
5. Power on system and check if system work as normal. ( Ex: cd to file folder, cp files, network ... )
6. AC cycle system and check if system work as normal

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. CPU frequency should be maximum value when runnig CPU stress tool
2. CPU frequency and power usage should become lower when thermal throttling
3. BMC SEL should have log about CPU thermal throttling
4. System should power off without problem
5. System should power on without problem
6. System should work without problem after AC cycle
note: CPU caution1: 95/caution2: 97 /caution3: 99  dgree C

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- PROCHOT Thermal Throttling (CPU): read CPU core temp + clock while loading to observe PROCHOT throttling sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "grep -H . /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp 2>&1; lscpu 2>&1 | grep -i MHz; stress-ng --cpu 8 --timeout 10s 2>&1 & sleep 3; grep -H . /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp 2>&1".
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the CPU temp + clock before/during/after the load so the user confirms whether PROCHOT engaged; full PROCHOT assertion may need controlled heating.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: stressing the CPU raises temperature; keep cooling adequate and run briefly.

original_test_intent: Induce controlled CPU PROCHOT throttling under maximum-power stress and reduced fan speed, prove simultaneous frequency/power reduction and SEL reporting, then restore cooling and verify power/AC recovery and basic functionality.
original_method: An approved controller runs the platform CPU workload, applies the validated all-fan-low profile under continuous limits, correlates temperature/frequency/power/fan/SEL evidence, powers off, restores fan policy, powers on, performs the approved AC cycle and runs file/network health checks.
manual_activity: No source step requires physical heating or observation. One authorized user may approve the unchanged high-risk automated plan and remain available for exceptional recovery; that does not make the normal core partial.
required_inputs: CPU/platform identity and authoritative PROCHOT/caution semantics
Approved Linpack/validation workload and maximum-power definition
BMC fan-low/restore interface, sensor map and SEL event identity
Continuous temperature/frequency/power/fan sampling plus abort thresholds
Approved power-off/on and AC-cycle method, recovery and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Continuously enforce owner limits and stop workload before unsafe temperature or on sensor/fan/OOB loss.
Never issue unvalidated fan control or assume 95/97/99 C are trip limits.
Restore fan policy before power-on recovery and verify actual RPM/profile.
Stop on the first PROCHOT/fan/power anomaly; no automatic retry or hidden failure.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, run the exact workload, fan profile, monitoring, SEL capture, recovery and functional checks.
Correlate PROCHOT timing with frequency and power reduction, not temperature alone.
Use the existing project/PA Manager cycle path for AC when approved and report measurements separately from engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve model-specific workload, thermal limits, fan and power recovery plan.
Provide exceptional physical recovery only if automation stops safely.
Interpret final acceptance and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The 10-second stress-ng sample is a diagnostic only and cannot replace Linpack/approved maximum-power load, fan-low control, SEL proof or recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the reviewed repository script and validated platform fan/power interfaces; retain DeepSeek reads only as supplemental telemetry if their sensor mapping is proven.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Maximum-power stress, all-fan-low state, frequency/power/SEL correlation, power recovery, AC cycle, 95/97/99 C note and 20/60-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: QUALIFY EXISTING OOB SCRIPT AND PLATFORM CONTROLS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use synchronized high-rate temperature, effective-frequency, package-power and fan telemetry with SEL event correlation, hard aborts and a finally-style fan restoration verified before recovery cycling.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact CPU, board, BMC and fan-controller implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record CPU microcode, BIOS, BMC/CPLD, kernel, workload and script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner CPU thermal specification, BMC fan-control/SEL specification and repository script revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds atomic restoration and evidence correlation without changing the intended stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; a short generic stress run is explicitly not equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Model thresholds, workload, fan mappings, sensors and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reported frequency may not equal effective frequency; telemetry and SEL clocks require synchronization.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different workload, duration or AC mechanism if it still reaches and proves the intended PROCHOT behavior. The record must state changed coverage and cannot claim source maximum-power or cycle coverage that was omitted.
expected_evidence: Approved CPU/BMC identity, workload, fan commands, thresholds, abort/recovery and authorization
Baseline and time-aligned temperature/frequency/power/fan telemetry plus workload output
PROCHOT SEL entry correlated with reduced frequency and power
Verified fan restoration, power-on/AC-cycle recovery, file/network health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently describes throttling before recovery. The caution thresholds are underdefined readiness data but do not contradict the expected PROCHOT behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Platform parameters and commands are required readiness inputs, not a permanent semantic block. With validated controls, the complete normal path is automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject its short incomplete substitute and PARTIAL label.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its safety and source coverage, but classify FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1 because approval and recovery availability do not make the normal core manual.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates high execution risk and readiness from automation capability.

review_improvement: Requires proof of simultaneous thermal, frequency, power and SEL response plus guaranteed fan restoration and full recovery coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: All intended controls and observations are software/BMC-accessible on a supported platform, including an approved nonphysical AC cycle. The case is high risk but not inherently manual; missing vendor parameters govern readiness rather than classification.
